teacher_intro_page.subtitle: Two friendly guides for our learning club.

introductions.name: Mrs Binta
introductions.intro: Hello! I'm Mrs Binta. I turn everyday things into maths games. I like curious questions and brave tries. In my class, a mistake is a chance to learn. Bring your ideas!

introductions.name: Mr Aliyu
introductions.intro: Hello! I'm Mr Aliyu. I enjoy number riddles and building games. I like asking, 'How did you know?' We will learn together in our next chapter. I can't wait to hear your ideas!
